text: I had my first colonic hydrotherapy here. The doctors made me feel comfortable and the 45 minutes went by fast. They are in tune with the body and recommended me next steps. There is also a cute kitty that will keep you company in the lobby (if you’re lucky!)

Wow! I am so thankful for this Ayurvedic center.  I arrived in Thailand two weeks ago and was already having intense poo problems from my 18 hour flight and quitting vaping (apparently constipation for weeks is a nasty side effect that is often unmentioned) .  I was close to going to the hospital from the pain after laxatives weren’t helping but decided to wait it out until my flight to Chiang Mai.

The colonic was amazing.  I’ve tried about 10 practitioners over the years and I’ve NEVER had the experience of two people caring for you at once.  One works the machine (I prefer closed system so this was great) and the other does hot oil abdominal massage the whole time.

I was so gassy and backed up I thought I might pass out and die during the experience but they helped me through the worst of it with encouragement.

I highly recommend PongPhat clinic and will be coming back for several more sessions in the next days along with other treatments for my whacked out Vata body.  🤪. Thank you!!
